Cursed Corpse Creation — Innate Technique (11th level)

At 11th level, you can put extra time and care into one of your favorite cursed corpses to make a masterpiece. You can choose one of your existing Cursed Corpses or when you make a new Cursed Corpse to be your Favorite. It gains the following:

  • It gains a +4 bonus to two of its Ability scores and their maximums for that score.

  • The damage die of all its attacks increases by one tier (D10<D12<2d8).

  • It gains 3 Mutations of your choice. You cannot select the same Mutation multiple times.
